mcq.question: Why are report totals the sum of *rounded* line amounts?

options.A: Rounding once at the end is not allowed by law
options.D: So the printed lines add up exactly to the printed total

mcq.explanation: Customers check the arithmetic. Summing unrounded values can make the total differ from the lines by a cent.

mcq.question: Why does `csv_field("=SUM(A1)")` add a leading `'`?

options.A: CSV requires quotes around equals signs
options.B: To mark the cell as a number
options.C: To stop spreadsheets from running the cell as a formula (CSV injection)
options.D: It is how Excel escapes commas

mcq.explanation: Formulas in exported data can run commands or leak data when a user opens the file.
